title: Requirements for Certification, Authorization or Special Permit Application

blocks.html: An application to the City Planning Commission for a certification, authorization or special permit respecting a development, enlargement, or site alteration shall include a survey map, prepared by a licensed land surveyor and dated no more than two years prior to the date of filing an application, showing:
blocks.plainText: An application to the City Planning Commission for a certification, authorization or special permit respecting a development, enlargement, or site alteration shall include a survey map, prepared by a licensed land surveyor and dated no more than two years prior to the date of filing an application, showing:

blocks.html: (a)    existing topography at two foot contour intervals;
blocks.plainText: (a) existing topography at two foot contour intervals;

blocks.html: (b)    the location of all existing buildings or other structures and the location of all proposed buildings or other structures;
blocks.plainText: (b) the location of all existing buildings or other structures and the location of all proposed buildings or other structures;

blocks.html: (c)    the location of individual existing trees of six inch caliper or more;
blocks.plainText: (c) the location of individual existing trees of six inch caliper or more;

blocks.html: (d)    the location of any elements of the open space network on or adjacent to the zoning lot; and
blocks.plainText: (d) the location of any elements of the open space network on or adjacent to the zoning lot; and

blocks.html: (e)    the location of any areas of no land alteration, streams, and natural watercourses;
blocks.plainText: (e) the location of any areas of no land alteration, streams, and natural watercourses;

blocks.html: and such other information as may be required by the Commission for its determination as to whether or not the certification, authorization or special permit is warranted.
blocks.plainText: and such other information as may be required by the Commission for its determination as to whether or not the certification, authorization or special permit is warranted.
